about: Ten real 311 reports from Tacoma, WA, taken from SeeClickFix, with labels taken from the source.

label_rules.team: The department that the Tacoma FIRST 311 page lists for the report's request type (see policy.txt).
label_rules.street_words: Words of the report's street address that also appear in the report text. Details must keep at least one in location.
label_rules.fact_check: The reply sentences are built from policy.txt and the ticket. expected_sources says which one backs up each sentence; null means nothing backs it up.
label_rules.privacy: The last sentence of each privacy text (name, phone or student number, email) is made up and added by us, because the public source data has no personal details. 555-01xx phone numbers and example.com email addresses are reserved for examples.
